edges.reason: Both sources report that South Africa's GDP fell/contracted by 0.2% for the second quarter of 2026. One uses 'fell by 0.2%' and the other 'contracted 0.2%'. They are independent reports of the same figure.

edges.sentence: On 2026-09-08, Reuters reported “Gross domestic product (GDP) contracted 0.2% on a seasonally adjusted quarter-on-quarter basis (ZAGDPN=ECI)”; on the same day, The Guardian reported “New data shows that South Africa’s GSP fell by 0.2% in April-June, ending a run of six quarters of growth in a row.”.
